is surrounded by mountains from one side and the sea on the other. A big amount of water near the shore is frozen. Evidence of human settlement can be seen, with several igloos and wooden towers being seen on the map. Multiple smaller hills and rocks can also be seen, alongside multiple icicles.

The path starts and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns to avoid the sea and the hills that surround the map.

was a small, snow-capped island with icebergs lying around the sea and island. There was a snow overpass spanning on side of the map, a sheer cliff face surrounding another side (where you could place cliff towers) and water surrounding the other sides. Evidence of human settlement could be seen, with several igloos seen.

The light grey pebble path began at a cave underneath the snow overpass and took a straight route to the cave at the end of the mountain. The path was more or less straight, though there were some corners to avoid natural environment.

was a small, ice-capped snow island with icebergs seen out in the sea. An ice overpass could be seen, with icy mountains covering most of the island. The icy mountain was jagged and steep, meaning cliff towers could not placed on it. Human settlement could be seen, with igloos and wooden outpost towers. You could place cliff towers on the outpost towers.

The grey path began at a cave underneath the ice overpass and ended at a cave at the far end of the ice mountain. The path took an indirect route, twisting around the artificial environment.

was a small, snow-capped island with icebergs seen out in the sea. A snow overpass could be spanning some of the map, with a stepped snow mountain surrounding most of the map. You could place cliff towers on the snow mountain. At the peak of the snow mountain was a Canadian flag, giving the significance of Canadian territory, probably signifying a minor settlement like Alert, Canada. The only presence of human habitation was the igloos sparsely populated around the map.

The white grey path began at a cave beside the ice overpass and ended at a cave at the far end of the ice mountain. The path took an indirect route, twisting around the artificial and natural environment.

was a very bright map due to an oversight, which could have caused a loss in focus because of the intensity of the brightness.
This bug was later fixed on 12th of March 2022.
In the first version of this map, a Canadian flag was flown on top of the mountain.
This was removed when the map was remade in the
was based on the South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, a British Overseas Territory in the southern Atlantic Ocean.

On the third version of the map, an outpost tower could be seen buried in the ice. However, because of how bright the map was, it was not possible to see it without free camera mode, which is not available to most people.
This outpost tower is a reference to the old versions of the map, where these were used as cliff spots.
No longer gives a badge upon first triumph.
